type.headline: serif, mixes upright and italic in one headline
type.accent: handwritten, for founder field notes only
type.case: sentence case or lowercase, never all caps

voice.register: confident, direct, reassuring; clinical but warm; short punchy fragments
pillars: Doctor-led. Real doctors make the medical calls.
Safety first. Screening and blood tests come before any medicine.
Personal. Plans built on your labs, history and goals.
Built for India. Local meals, culture and appetite.
A planned exit. Habits that last after the medicine stops.
sampleLines: Metabolic care, calibrated for Indian biology.
Before you start, hear it from a doctor, not a reel.
No obligation. If it isn't right for you, they'll say so.

hardBans: no promoting a specific prescription drug or brand
no weight-loss promises, no kilos, no timelines
no claim without a traceable source
audience: Adults in India who have tried diets, have heard of GLP-1 medicines, and are curious but sceptical. Worried about safety, muscle loss, side effects and regaining weight.
